description: This file provides a module for loading machine learning models (LSTM and U-Net) for a flood risk prediction platform. It includes placeholder functions for loading models in various formats, and functions for performing predictions and managing uploaded models, though actual implementation details are marked as TODO. The code is intended to support future integrations for different model formats and versioning.

methods.description: Generates flood risk predictions using the LSTM model, currently as a stub returning an empty list.
